separation_note: Executed reproductions only. Hypotheses are frozen separately in hypotheses.json; proposed mechanism changes are in mechanism-change.json; unbound proposals are in strategy-proposals.json.

workload_sanitization.policy: The live ledger is read only. Every injected-fault reproduction runs against synthetic fixtures in a PO03-FX-* namespace with identifiers derived by SHA-256 over fixture labels.

reproductions.name: Live ledger reconstruction
reproductions.design: Scan the repository's own append-only ledger at the immutable controller base with a pinned evaluation instant, and reconstruct current Obzio state for every task identifier it names.

reproductions.name: Self-lineage reconstruction
reproductions.design: Without reading its own immutable task input, check whether the scanner reconstructs this attempt's identity from the event stream alone, then compare the reconstruction to the dispatch record.
reproductions.note: AWAITING_DISPATCH is the correct reconstruction of the ledger as committed at the controller base. It is also a live finding: no DISPATCH_DELIVERED or RUNNING event for this attempt exists at that commit even though the attempt is executing. See limitations.json L-05.

reproductions.name: Independent cross-check against the controller's own recovery projection
reproductions.design: Ledger reconstruction is an independent derivation of state; recovery-state.json is a separately maintained projection. For every lease the projection declares LEASED or RUNNING, compare reconstructed state, lease_id and fence_token.
reproductions.significance: Two independently maintained views of the same fleet agree exactly, which is the property a recovery scanner must have before it is trusted to drive replay.

reproductions.name: Committed-not-ingested detection under a lost return callback
Provider-completed-uncommitted detection (PO-02 Code-2 structural analogue)
reproductions.significance: The classification depends on fusing the ledger with the provider observation. The ledger alone cannot distinguish a silently dead run from a live one before its lease expires, which is recorded as limitation L-02.

reproductions.name: Mixed fleet separated in one pass
reproductions.significance: This is the falsifier for the primary hypothesis' conflation clause: the two target dispositions are separated, in the presence of four other dispositions, with provider COMPLETED observations present on units that do hold durable commits.

reproductions.name: Fault matrix across the remaining injected classes
reproductions.design: Each remaining fixture injects one fault after a state transition and asserts the required refusal or classification.

reproductions.name: Parent-restart idempotence and determinism
reproductions.design: Simulate parent restart by rescanning each fixture three times and comparing canonical report digests; separately rewrite every ledger line with reversed key order and different JSON spacing and compare the reconstruction.

reproductions.name: Clean-clone recurrence
reproductions.design: From a fresh clone made with --no-hardlinks at the immutable result commit, read every manifest artifact back by digest and byte count, then rerun the fixture, focused, seeded and taxonomy checks against expectations frozen beforehand.
reproductions.observed: See recurrence-evidence.json and readback-verification.json for the executed values.
